title: Add opt-in unpublishOldVersions setting to unpublish stale PTE app versions after deploy
summary: AL-Go now supports an opt-in setting to automatically unpublish old, uninstalled versions of Per Tenant Extensions after deployment, keeping the Extension Management list clean and reducing clutter.
key_points: New optional unpublishOldVersions boolean property on DeployTo environment settings, disabled by default
After deployment, the system identifies and unpublishes only versions that are uninstalled and older than an installed version of the same app
Uses Automation API v2.0 endpoint Microsoft.NAV.unpublish to perform the cleanup
Operation is non-fatal and wrapped in error handling to never block deployments
Only applies to Per Tenant Extension deployment path; existing users see zero behavior change
quote: Automatically clean up those stale versions right after a successful deployment.
